recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: cool clear night over SF, gusts brushing the ridges
shop talk about shaving frontier inference bills with sharper models
sponsor seams creeping into conversational answers where none were before
CI guardrails coughing on over-eager malware prompts
stutter pulses and mellow house stacking in nighttime headphones
late-year posts still pinning 'imagine 2026' while feeds go quiet

composer-2-fast.concept: Twin beat-lanes collide in the center—you tap only when stutter-aligned pulses fuse, scoring chain merges instead of lone hits.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm-merge timing taps on approaching lane convergence windows.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Single-thumb taps when converging pulses align.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Each clean merge ramps a visible combo bar that peaks before the loop ends.
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM ticks up and lane skew randomizes so timing windows shorten.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon wireframe tunnel with nightclub bloom and quantized shockwaves.

gpt-5.4-high-fast.concept: Slide a luminous runner through a marine-layer corridor—lanes alternate between fogged-out dead zones and clear scoring strips.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.mechanic: Lane dodge / switch avoiding obscured segments.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.session_hook: Unbroken clear-streak combos feel like punching through thinning fog.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.escalation: Fog pulses faster and veil opacity eats peripheral UI chrome.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.aesthetic: Watercolor dusk over the bay—pastel silhouettes behind drifting mist.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Split a pile of oddly weighted tokens onto two quotas—economy-grade vs premium-heavy—until both budget meters land in the green simultaneously.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Sort-drag resource allocation puzzle with hidden coupling between piles.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Drag each token onto one of two plates.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: The meters tick visibly; matching both targets snaps with a crisp settle.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Wildcard tokens invert weights or tether pairs mid-round.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Pastel SaaS dashboards with faint vapor-chrome trims.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: A terminal chat fills with intrusive sponsor glyphs—tap them away before they cover the coherent text fragments you must protect.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Precision multitap on clutter overlays before readability bar hits zero.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Tap sponsor orbs atop lines of fake copy.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Keeping legibility percentage high feels like clearing noisy UI under time pressure.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Glyphs stack faster, shrink hitboxes, spawn decoy pings.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: CRT-phosphor green/black with jittered scanlines and soft bloom bleed.

kimi-k2.5.concept: One continuous ink stroke gathers dew blobs along looping rose stems—you lift at the wrong moment and ink snaps like a broken melody.
kimi-k2.5.mechanic: Single-draw path-collection with brittle stem obstacles.
kimi-k2.5.touch_control: Draw path hold to preview; release commits the line.
kimi-k2.5.session_hook: Completing a closed loop resets dew without breaking flow feels like humming a refrain.
kimi-k2.5.escalation: Thorns multiply on stems and allowable draw time contracts.
kimi-k2.5.aesthetic: Gouache Scandinavian spring vignette—muted sage, blush pink, graphite stems.
